title: Tanahashi earns the Ace’s place
summary: Hiroshi Tanahashi becomes a new focal point for New Japan after a turbulent period. Winning the vacant title begins the process; defeating his idol Keiji Muto at the Dome gives it a generational payoff.

chapters.title: Tanahashi wins his first IWGP title
chapters.result: Tanahashi defeats Giant Bernard in the vacant-title tournament final.
chapters.context: The result places the company’s main championship on a rising homegrown wrestler and begins his first reign.

chapters.title: The student defeats his idol
chapters.result: Tanahashi defeats Muto for the IWGP heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The Dome main event turns admiration into competition: Tanahashi must surpass the star whose style helped inspire his own.
